paragraphs: Hi! I'm Pavel — a Frontend Developer with commercial experience creating interactive interfaces, landing pages, and complex animations.
I'm open to interesting challenges and projects — I'd be glad to become part of your team!

experience.title: My Experience
experience.description: Developed interactive promo pages and web applications with a focus on performance and expressive animations. Initiated architecture optimization, implemented a component-based approach, and built standardized modular solutions that reduced time-to-market for new products.

projects.name: Stellar Burgers
projects.desc: A training project completed as part of the Yandex Practicum course, featuring a web application for building space-themed burgers and placing online orders. The functionality includes a drag-and-drop constructor, authentication, a personal account, and real-time order status tracking via WebSocket.

projects.name: M.Labs
projects.desc: A personal single-page promotional website for a fictional agency, created to practice working with GSAP and inspired by the visual identity of Nothing and Awwwards. The interface features a Hero section slider with scroll-linked animations, an interactive SVG mask, cursor-responsive elements, and smooth scrolling powered by Lenis.
